title: Heated bar natural frequencies
line: A thermal-stress FEA study of the natural frequencies of a steel bar clamped at both ends and heated 200 K.
description: Natural frequencies of a steel bar (1000 x 100 x 100 mm) clamped at both ends and heated 200 K. The clamps stop it growing, so it carries 5040 kN of axial compression that softens its bending modes. A thermal step, a preload and a prestressed modal step return the first two modes of the hot bar.
thumbnailAlt: First bending mode of a hot steel bar clamped at both ends, solved in RunMat
